About Pendle

Pendle is a DeFi protocol that splits yield-bearing assets into principal and yield tokens so users can trade future yield. PENDLE is used for governance and fee sharing.

Where this PENDLE price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (PENDLE-USD), Binance (PENDLE/USDT) and Kraken (PENDLE/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 169,241,000 PENDLE (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
